# OpenVR SDK headers

Source: https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr
Tag: `v2.15.6`
Commit: `0924064316de3effbcd1acf1e309182a2deb1c05`

Only the C API and driver headers are vendored. They match the SDK interfaces used by this project (`IVRSystem_026`). SteamVR binaries and render resources are not included. License: BSD-3-Clause; see `LICENSE`.
